title: Duas.org

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْألُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيٍْء
segments.transliteration: allahumma in-ni as-aluka bi-rah-matikal-lati wasi`at kul-la shay
segments.translation: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy, which embraces all things;

segments.arabic: وَبِقُوَّتِكَ الَّتِي قَهَرْتَ بِهَا كُلَّ شَيٍْء
segments.transliteration: wa bi-qu-watikal-lati qahar-ta biha kul-la shay
segments.translation: And by Your strength, through which You dominatest all things,

segments.arabic: وَخَضَعَ لَهَا كُلُّ شَيٍْء
segments.translation: And toward which all things are humble

segments.arabic: وَذَلَّ لَهَا كُلُّ شَيٍْء
segments.translation: And before which all things are lowly;

segments.arabic: وَبِجَبرُوتِكَ الَّتِي غَلَبْتَ بِهَا كُلَّ شَيٍْء
segments.transliteration: wa bi-jabarutikal-lati ghalab-ta biha kul-la shay
segments.translation: And by Your invincibility through which You overwhelmest all things,

segments.arabic: وَبِعِزَّتِكَ الَّتِي لا يَقُومُ لَهَا شَيْءٌ
segments.transliteration: wa bi`izzatikal-lati la yaqumu laha shay
segments.translation: And by Your might, which nothing can resist;

segments.arabic: وَبِعَظَمَتِكَ الَّتِي مَلأَتْ كُلَّ شَيٍْء
segments.translation: And by Your tremendousness, which has filled all things;

segments.arabic: وَبِسُلْطَانِكَ الَّذِي عَلاَ كُلَّ شَيٍْء
segments.translation: by Your force, which towers over all things;

segments.arabic: وَبِوَجْهِكَ الْبَاقِي بَعْدَ فَنَاءِ كُلِّ شَيٍْء
segments.transliteration: wa bi-waj-hikal-baqi ba`da fana-i kul-li shay
segments.translation: And by Your face, which subsists after the annihilation of all things,

segments.arabic: وَبِأَسْمَائِكَ الَّتِي مَلأَتْ أَرْكَانَ كُلِّ شَيٍْء
segments.transliteration: wa bi-as-ma-ikal-lati malat ar-kana kul-li shay
segments.translation: And by Your Names, which have filled the foundations of all things;

segments.arabic: وَبِعِلْمِكَ الَّذِي أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيٍْء
segments.translation: And by Your knowledge, which encompasses all things;

segments.arabic: وَبِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ الَّذِي أَضَاءَ لَهُ كُلُّ شَيٍْء
segments.transliteration: wa bi-nuri waj-hikal-ladhi ada-a lahu kul-lu shay
segments.translation: And by the light of Your face, through which all things are illumined!

segments.arabic: يَا نُورُ يَا قُدُّوسُ
segments.translation: O Light! O All-holy!

segments.arabic: يَا أَوَّلَ الأَوَّلِينَ
segments.translation: O First of those who are first

segments.arabic: وَيَا آخِرَ الآخِرِينَ
segments.translation: And O Last of those who are last!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تَهتِكُ الْعِصَمَ
segments.translation: O Allah, forgive me those sins which tear apart safeguards!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُنْزِلُ النِّقَمَ
segments.translation: O Allah, forgive me those sins which draw down adversities!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُغيِّرُ النِّعَمَ
segments.translation: O Allah, forgive me those sins which alter blessings!

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تَحْبِسُ الدُّعَاءَ
segments.translation: O Allah forgive me those sins which hold back supplication!

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تَقْطَعُ الرََّّجَاءَ
segments.translation: O Allah forgive me those sins which cut down the hopes!

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُنْزِلُ البَلاءَ
segments.translation: O Allah, forgive me those sins which draw down tribulation!

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي كُلَّ ذَنْبٍ أَذْنَبْتُهُ وَكُلَّ خَطِيئَةٍ أَخْطَأْتُهَا
segments.transliteration: allahumma-igh-fir liya kul-la dham-bin adhnabtuhu wa kul-la khati-atin akh-tatuha
segments.translation: O Allah, forgive me every sin I have committed and every mistake I have made!

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَيْكَ بِذِكْرِكَ
segments.translation: O Allah, verily I seek nearness to You through remembrance of You,

segments.arabic: وَأَسْتَشْفِعُ بِكَ إِلَي نَفْسِكَ
segments.translation: And I seek intercession from You with Yourself,

segments.arabic: وَأَسْألُكَ بِجُودِكَ أَن تُدْنِيَنِي مِن قُرْبِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa as-aluka bi-judika an tud-ni-yani min qur-bik
segments.translation: And I ask You through Your munificence to bring me near to Your proximity,

segments.arabic: وَأَن تُوزِعَنِي شُكْرَكَ
segments.translation: And to provide me with gratitude toward You

segments.arabic: وَأَن تُلْهِمَنِي ذِكْرَكَ
segments.translation: And to inspire me with Your remembrance.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْألُكَ سُؤَالَ خَاضِعٍ مُّتَذَلِّلٍ خَاشِعٍ أَن تُسَامِحَنِي وَتَرْحَمَنِي
segments.transliteration: allahumma in-ni as-luka suala khadii'm-mutadhal-lilin kha-shii'n an tusamihani wa tar-hamani
segments.translation: O Allah, verily I ask You with the asking of a submissive, abased and lowly man to show me forbearance, to have mercy on me

segments.arabic: وَتَجْعلَنِي بِقَسَمِكَ رَاضِياً قَانِعاً، وَفِي جَمِيعِ الأَحْوَاِل مُتَوَاضِعاً
segments.transliteration: wa taj-`alani bi-qasamika radiyan qani`n wa fi jamii'l-ah-wali mutawadi`aa
segments.translation: And to make me satisfied and content with Your appointment and [make me] humble in every state.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَأَسْألُكَ سُؤَالَ مَنِ اشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتُهُ
segments.transliteration: allahumma wa as-aluka suala manish-tad-dat faqatuh
segments.translation: O Allah, I ask You the question of one whose indigence is extreme,

segments.arabic: وَأَنزَلَ بِكَ عِنْدَ الشَّدَائِدِ حَاجَتَهُ
segments.translation: And who has stated to You in difficulties his need

segments.arabic: وَعَظُمَ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ رَغْبَتُهُ
segments.translation: And whose desire for what is with You has become great.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ عَظُمَ سُلْطَانُكَ وَعَلاَ مَكَانُكَ
segments.translation: O Allah, Your force is tremendous, Your place is lofty,

segments.arabic: وَخَفِي مَكْرُكَ وَظَهَرَ أَمْرُكَ
segments.translation: And Your plan is hidden, Your command is manifest,

segments.arabic: وَغَلَبَ قَهْرُكَ وَجَرَتْ قُدْرَتُكَ
segments.transliteration: wa ghalaba qah-ruka wa jarat qud-ratuk
segments.translation: And Your domination is overwhelming, Your power is unhindered

segments.arabic: وَلا يُمْكِنُ الْفِرَارُ مِنْ حُكُومَتِكَ
segments.translation: And escape from Your governance is impossible.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لا أَجِدُ لِذُنُوبِي غَافِراً
segments.translation: O Allah, I find no forgiver of my sins,

segments.arabic: وَّلا لِقَبَائِحِي سَاتِراً
segments.translation: Nor concealer of my ugly acts

segments.arabic: وَّلا لِشَيٍْء مِّنْ عَمَلِي الْقَبِيحِ بِالْحَسَنِ مُبَدِّلاً غَيْرَكَ
segments.translation: Nor transformer of any of my ugly acts into good acts but You

segments.arabic: لا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنتَ
segments.translation: There is no god but You!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ وَبِحَمْدِكَ
segments.translation: Glory be to You, and Thine is the praise!

segments.arabic: ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي
segments.translation: I have wronged myself,

segments.arabic: وَتَجَرَّأْتُ بِجَهْلِي
segments.translation: And I have been audacious in my ignorance

segments.arabic: وَسَكَنتُ إِلَي قَدِيمِ ذِكْرِكَ لِي وَمَنِّكَ عَلَيَّ
segments.transliteration: wa sakan-tu ila qadimi dhik-rika li wa man-nika `alay
segments.translation: And I have depended upon Your ancient remembrance of me and Your favour toward me.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ مَوْلايَ
segments.translation: O Allah! O my Protector!

segments.arabic: كَم مِّن قَبِيحٍ سَتَرْتَهُ
segments.translation: How many ugly things You hast concealed!

segments.arabic: وَكَم مِّن فَاِدحٍ مِّنَ البَلاءِ أَقَلْتَهُ
segments.translation: How many burdensome tribulations You hast abolished!

segments.arabic: وَكَم مِّنْ عِثَارٍ وَّقَيْتَهُ
segments.translation: And how many stumbles You hast prevented!

segments.arabic: وَكَم مِّن مَّكْرُوهٍ دَفَعْتَهُ
segments.translation: And how many ordeals You hast repelled!

segments.arabic: وَكَم مِّن ثَنَاٍء جَمِيلٍ لَّسْتُ أَهْلاً لَّهُ نَشَرْتَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa kam-min thana-in jamilil-las-tu ah-lal-lahu nashar-tah
segments.translation: And how much beautiful praise, for which I was unworthy, You hast spread abroad!

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ عَظُمَ بَلائِي
segments.translation: O Allah, my tribulation is tremendous,

segments.arabic: وَأَفْرَطَ بِي سُوءُ حَاِلي
segments.translation: And my bad state is excessive,

segments.arabic: وَقَصُرَتْ بِي أَعْمَاِلي
segments.translation: And my acts are inadequate,

segments.arabic: وَقَعَدَتْ بِي أَغْلاَلِي
segments.translation: And my fetters have tied me down,

segments.arabic: وَحَبَسَنِي عَن نَّفْعِي بُعْدُ آمَاِلي
segments.translation: And my far-fetched hopes have held me back from my gain

segments.arabic: وَخَدَعَتْنِي الدُّنْيَا بِغُرُورِهَا وَنَفْسِي بِجِنَايَتِهَا وَمِطَاِلي
segments.transliteration: wa khada`at-nid-dunya bi-ghururi-ha wa naf-si bi-jinayatiha wa mita-li
segments.translation: And this world with its delusions, my own soul with its offences and my delay have deceived me.

segments.arabic: يَا سَيِّدِي فَأَسْألُكَ بِعِزَّتِكَ أَن لا يَحْجُبَ عَنْكَ دُعَائِي سُوءُ عَمَلِي وَفِعَاِلي
segments.transliteration: ya say-yidi fa-as-aluka bi-i'z-zatika an la yah-juba `an-ka du`aa-i suo-u `amali wa fi`ali
segments.translation: O my Master! So I ask You by Your might not to let my evil works and acts veil my supplication from You,

segments.arabic: وَلا تَفْضَحَنِي بِخَفِيِّ مَا اطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ سِرِّي
segments.transliteration: wa-la taf-dah-ni bi-khafi-yi mat-tala`ta `ailayhi min sir-ri
segments.translation: And not to disgrace me through the hidden things You knowest of my secrets

segments.arabic: وَلا تُعَاجِلْنِي بِالْعُقُوبَةِ عَلَى مَا عَمِلْتُهُ فِي خَلَوَاتِي
segments.transliteration: wa-la tu`ajil-ni bil-u'qubati `ala ma `amil-tuhu fi khalawati
segments.translation: And not to hasten me to punishment for what I have done in private:

segments.arabic: مِنْ سُوءِ فِعْلِي وَإِسَاءَتِي،
segments.translation: My evil acts in secrecy and my misdeeds

segments.arabic: وَدَوَامِ تَفْرِيطِي وَجَهَالَتِي
segments.translation: And my continuous negligence and my ignorance

segments.arabic: وَكَثْرَةِ شَهَوَاتِي وَغَفْلَتِي
segments.translation: And my manifold passions and my forgetfulness.

segments.arabic: وَكُنِ اَللَّهُمَّ بِعِزَّتِكَ لِي فِي كُلِّ الأَحْوَاِل رَؤُوفاً
segments.transliteration: wa kunil-lahumma bi-i'z-zatika li fi kul-lil-ah-wali ra’ufa
segments.translation: And by Your might, O Allah, be kind to me in all states

segments.arabic: وَّعَلَيَّ فِي جَمِيعِ الأُمُورِ عَطُوفاً
segments.translation: And be gracious to me in all affairs!

segments.arabic: إِلَهِي وَرَبِّي مَن لِّي غَيْرُكَ أَسْألُهُ كَشْفَ ضُرِّي وَالْنَّظَرَ فِي أَمْرِي!
segments.transliteration: ilahi wa rab-bi mal-li ghayruka as-aluhu kash-fa dur-ri wan-nazara fi am-ri!
segments.translation: My God and my Lord! Have I any but You from whom to ask removal of my affliction and regard for my affairs!

segments.arabic: إِلَهِي وَمَوْلاي أَجْرَيْتَ عَلَيَّ حُكْماً اتَّبَعْتُ فِيهِ هَوَى نَفْسِي،
segments.transliteration: ilahi wa maw-laya aj-rayta `alay-ya huk-mant-taba`tu fihi hawa naf-si
segments.translation: My God and my Protector! You put into effect through me a decree in which I followed the caprice of my own soul

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ أَحْتَرِسْ فِيهِ مِن تَزْيينِ عَدُوِّي،
segments.transliteration: wa lam ah-taris fihi min tazyini `adu-wi
segments.translation: And [I] did not remain wary of adorning my enemy.

segments.arabic: فَغَرَّنِي بِمَا أَهْوَى وَأَسْعَدَهُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ القَضَاءُ
segments.transliteration: fa-ghar-rani bi-ma ah-wa wa as-`adahu `ala dha-likal-qada
segments.translation: So he deluded me through my soul's caprice and therein destiny favoured him

segments.arabic: فَتَجَاوَزْتُ بِمَا جَرَى عَلَيَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ بَعْضَ حُدُودِكَ
segments.transliteration: fa-taja-waztu bi-ma jara `alay-ya min dha-lika ba`da hududik
segments.translation: So, in what was put into effect through me in that situation, I transgressed some of Your statutes

segments.arabic: وَخَالَفْتُ بَعْضَ أَوَامِرِكَ
segments.translation: And disobeyed some of Your commands.

segments.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحُجَّةُ عَلَيَّ فِي جَمِيعِ ذَلِكَ
segments.translation: So Thine is the argument against me in all of that

segments.arabic: وَلا حُجَّةَ لِي فِيمَا جَرَي عَلَيَّ فِيهِ قَضَاؤُكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-la huj-jata li fima jara `alay-ya fihi qadauka
segments.translation: I have no argument in what Your destiny put into effect through me therein

segments.arabic: وَأَلْزَمَنِي حُكْمُكَ وَبَلاؤُكَ
segments.translation: nor in what Your decree and Your tribulation imposed upon me.

segments.arabic: وَقَدْ أَتَيْتُكَ يَا إِلَهِي بَعْدَ تَقْصِيرِي وَإِسْرَافِي عَلَى نَفْسِي
segments.transliteration: wa qad ataytuka ya ilahi ba`da taq-siri wa is-rafi `ala naf-si
segments.translation: Now I have come to You, My God, after my shortcoming and my immoderation toward myself,

segments.arabic: مُعْتَذِراً نَّادِماً،
segments.translation: Proffering my excuse, regretful,

segments.arabic: مُّنْكَسِراً مُّسْتَقِيلاً
segments.translation: Broken, apologizing,

segments.arabic: مُّسْتَغْفِراً مُّنِيباً،
segments.translation: Asking forgiveness, repenting,

segments.arabic: مُّقِرّاً مُّذْعِناً مُّعْتَرِفاً
segments.translation: Acknowledging, submissive, confessing.

segments.arabic: لا أَجِدُ مَفَرّاً مِّمَّا كَانَ مِنِّي
segments.translation: I find no place to flee from what occurred through me,

segments.arabic: وَلا مَفْزَعاً أَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْهِ في أَمْرِي
segments.transliteration: wa-la mafza'an atawaj-jahu ilayhi fi am-ri
segments.translation: Nor any place of escape to which I may turn in my affairs,

segments.arabic: غَيْرَ قَبُولِكَ عُذْرِي، وَإِدخَاِلكَ إِيَاي فِي سَعَةٍ مِّن رَّحْمَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: ghayra qabulika u'dhri wa id-khalika i-yaya fi sa'tim-mir-rah-matik
segments.translation: Other than Your acceptance of my excuse and Your entering me into the compass of Your mercy.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ فَاقْبَل عُذْرِي
segments.translation: O Allah, so accept my excuse,

segments.arabic: وَارْحَمْ شِدَّةَ ضُرِّي
segments.translation: Have mercy upon the severity of my affliction

segments.arabic: وَفُكَّنِي مِن شَدِّ وَثَاقِي
segments.translation: And release me from the tightness of my fetters,

segments.arabic: يَا رَبِّ ارْحَمْ ضَعْفَ بَدَنِي وَرِقَّةَ جِلْدِي وَدِقَّةَ عَظْمِي
segments.transliteration: ya rab-bir-ham da`fa badani wa riq-qata jil-di wa diq-qata `azmi
segments.translation: My Lord, have mercy upon the weakness of my body, the thinness of my skin and the frailty of my bones.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ بَدَأَ خَلْقِي وَذِكْرِي وَتَرْبِيَتِي وَبِرِّي وَتَغْذِيَتِي
segments.transliteration: ya mam bada khal-qi wa dhik-ri wa tar-bi-yati wa biri wa tagh-dhi-yati
segments.translation: O You who gave rise to my creation, to the remembrance of me, to the nurture of me, to goodness toward me and to nourishment on me,

segments.arabic: هَبْنِي لابْتِدَاءِ كَرَمِكَ وَسَاِلفِ بِرِّكَ بِي
segments.transliteration: hab-ni lb-tida-i karamika wa salifi bir-rika bi
segments.translation: Bestow upon me for the sake of Your having given rise [to me] with generosity and Your previous goodness to me!

segments.arabic: يَا إِلَهِي وَسَيِّدِي وَرَبِّي
segments.transliteration: ya ilahi wa say-yidi wa rab-bi
segments.translation: O Allah, my Master and my Lord!

segments.arabic: أَتُرَاكَ مُعَذِّبِي بِنَارِكَ بَعْدَ تَوْحِيدِكَ
segments.translation: Canst You see Yourself tormenting me with Your fire after I have professed Your Unity

segments.arabic: وَبَعْدَ مَا انْطَوَى عَلَيْهِ قَلْبِي مِن مَّعْرِفَتِكَ
segments.translation: And after the knowledge of You my heart has embraced,

segments.arabic: وَلَهِجَ بِهِ لِسَانِي مِنْ ذِكْرِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa lahija bihi lisani min dhik-rik
segments.translation: And the remembrance of You my tongue has constantly mentioned

segments.arabic: وَاعْتَقَدَهُ ضَمِيرِي مِنْ حُبِّكَ
segments.translation: And the love of You to which my mind has clung,

segments.arabic: وَبَعْدَ صِدْقِ اعْتِرَافِي وَدُعَائِي خَاضِعاً لِّرُبُوبِيَّتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa ba`da sid-qi-`a-tirafi wa du`aa-i khadi`aal-li-rububi-yatika
segments.translation: And after the sincerity of my confession and my supplication, humble before Your lordship?

segments.arabic: هَيْهَاتَ أَنتَ أَكْرَمُ مِنْ أَن تُضَيِّعَ مَن رَّبَّيْتَهُ
segments.transliteration: hayhata anta ak-ramu min an tuday-yi`a mar-rab-baytah
segments.translation: Far be it from You! You art more generous than that You shouldst squander him whom You hast nurtured,

segments.arabic: أَوْ تُبْعِدَ مَنْ أَدْنَيْتَهُ
segments.translation: Or banish him whom You hast brought nigh,

segments.arabic: أَوْ تُشَرِّدَ مَنْ آوَيْتَهُ
segments.translation: Or drive away him whom You hast given an abode

segments.arabic: أَوْ تُسْلِّمَ إِلىَ الْبلاءِ مَن كَفَيْتَهُ وَرَحِمْتَهُ
segments.transliteration: aw tus-s-lima ilal-bala-i man kafay-tahu wa rahim-tah
segments.translation: Or submit to tribulation him whom You hast spared and shown mercy.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْتَ شِعْرِي يَا سَيِّدِي وَإِلَهِي وَمَوْلاي
segments.transliteration: wa layta shi`a-ri yay say-yidi wa ilahi wa maw-lay
segments.translation: Would that I knew, my Master, My God and my Protector,

segments.arabic: أَتُسَلِّطُ النَّارَ عَلَى وُجُوهٍ خَرَّتْ لِعَظَمَتِكَ سَاجِدَةً
segments.translation: Whether You wilt give the Fire dominion over faces fallen down prostrate before Your Tremendousness,

segments.arabic: وَّعَلَى أَلْسُنٍ نَّطَقَتْ بِتَوْحِيدِكَ صَادِقَةً وَّبِشُكْرِكَ مَادِحَةً
segments.transliteration: wa `ala al-sunin-nataqat bi-taw-hidika sadiqataw-wa bishuk-rika madihah
segments.translation: And over tongues voicing sincerely the profession of Your Unity and giving thanks to You in praise,

segments.arabic: وَّعَلَى قُلُوبٍ اعْتَرَفَتْ بِإِلَهِيَّتِكَ مُحَقِّقَةً
segments.translation: And over hearts acknowledging Your Divinity through verification,

segments.arabic: وَّعَلَى ضَمَائِرَ حَوَتْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ بِكَ حَتَّى صَارَتْ خَاشِعَةً
segments.transliteration: wa `ala dama-ira hawat minal-i'l-mi bika hat-ta sarat khashi`ah
segments.translation: And over minds encompassing knowledge of You until they have become humble

segments.arabic: وَّعَلَى جَواِرحَ سَعَتْ إِلَى أَوْطَانِ تَعَبُّدِكَ طَائِعَةً وَّأَشَارَتْ بِاسْتِغْفَارِكَ مُذْعِنَةً
segments.transliteration: wa `ala jawariha sa't ila aw-tani ta'b-budika ta-i`ataw-wa asharat bis-tigh-farika mudhi'nah
segments.translation: And over bodily members speeding to the places of Your worship in obedience and beckoning for Your forgiveness in submission.

segments.arabic: مَّا هَكَذَا الظَّنُّ بِكَ وَلا أُخْبِرْنَا بِفَضْلِكَ عَنكَ
segments.transliteration: ma hkadhaz-zan-nu bika wa-la ukh-bir-na bi-fadlika `anka
segments.translation: No such opinion is held of You! Nor has such been reported - thanks to Your bounty — concerning You,

segments.arabic: يَا كَرِيمُ، يَا رَبِّ
segments.translation: O All-generous! My Lord,

segments.arabic: وَأَنتَ تَعْلَمُ ضَعْفِي عَن قَلِيلٍ مِّن بَلاءِ الدُّنْيَا وَعُقُوبَاتِهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa anta ta`lamu da`fi `an qalilim-min bala-id-dun-ya wa u'qubatiha
segments.translation: And You knowest my weakness before a little of this world's tribulations and punishments,

segments.arabic: وَمَا يَجْرِي فِيهَا مِنَ الْمَكَارِهِ عَلَى أَهْلِهَا
segments.transliteration: wa ma yaj-ri fiha minal-makarihi `ala ah-liha
segments.translation: And before those ordeals which befall its inhabitants,

segments.arabic: عَلَى أَنَّ ذَلِكَ بَلاءٌ وَّمَكْرُوهٌ، قَلِيلٌ مَّكْثُهُ، يَسِيرٌ بَقَاؤُهُ، قَصِيرٌ مُّدَّتُهُ
segments.transliteration: `ala an-na dha-lika bala-uw-wa mak-ruhun, qalilum-mak-thuhu, yasirum baqa-uhu, qasirum-mud-datuh
segments.translation: Even though it is a tribulation and ordeal whose stay is short, whose subsistence is but little and, whose period is but fleeting.

segments.arabic: فَكَيْفَ احْتِمَاِلي لِبَلاءِ الآخِرَةِ وَجَلِيلِ وُقُوعِ الْمَكَارِهِ فِيهَا!
segments.transliteration: fa-kayfah-timali li-bala-il-akhirati wa jalili wuqui'l-makarihi fiha!
segments.translation: So how can I endure the tribulations of the next world and the great ordeals that occur within it?

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ بَلاءٌ تَطُولُ مُدَّتُهُ، وَيَدُومُ مَقَامُهُ، وَلا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْ أَهْلِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa huwa bala-un tatulu mud-datuhu, wa yadumu maqamuhu, wa-la yukhaf-fafu `an ah-lih
segments.translation: For it is a tribulation whose period is long, whose station endures and whose sufferers are given no respite,

segments.arabic: لأَنَّهُ لا يَكُونُ إِلاَّ عَنْ غَضَبِكَ وَانتِقَامِكَ وَسَخَطِكَ
segments.transliteration: li-an-nahu la yakunu il-la `an ghadabika wan-tiqamika wa sakhatik
segments.translation: Since it only occurs as a result of Your wrath, Your vengeance and Your anger,

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا مَا لا تَقُومُ لَهُ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالأَرْضُ
segments.transliteration: wa hadha ma la taqumu lahus-samawatu wal-ardu
segments.translation: And these cannot be withstood by the heavens and the earth.

segments.arabic: يَا سَيِّدِي فَكَيْفَ بِي
segments.translation: O Master, so what about me?!

segments.arabic: وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ الضَّعِيفُ الذَّلِيلُ الْحَقِيرُ الْمِسْكِينُ الْمُسْتَكِينُ
segments.translation: For I am Your weak, lowly, base, wretched and miserable slave.

segments.arabic: يَا إِلَهِي وَرَبِّي وَسَيِّدِي وَمَوْلاي
segments.transliteration: ya ilahi wa rab-bi wa say-yidi wa maw-lay
segments.translation: My God! My Lord! My Master! My Protector!

segments.arabic: لأَيِّ الأُمُورِ إِلَيْكَ أَشْكُو
segments.translation: For which things would I complain to You?

segments.arabic: وَلِمَا مِنْهَا أَضِجُّ وَأَبْكِي
segments.transliteration: wa lima minha adij-ju wa ab-ki
segments.translation: And for which of them would I lament and weep?

segments.arabic: لأَلِيمِ الْعَذَابِ وَشِدَّتِهِ!
segments.translation: For the pain and severity of chastisement?

segments.arabic: أَمْ لِطُولِ الْبَلاءِ وَمُدَّتِهِ!
segments.translation: Or for the length and period of tribulation?

segments.arabic: فَلَئِن صَيَّرْتَنِي لِلْعُقُوبَاتِ مَعَ أَعْدَائِكَ
segments.translation: So if You takest me to the punishments with Your enemies,

segments.arabic: وَجَمَعْتَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ أَهْلِ بَلائِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa jama`ta bayni wa bayna ahli bala-ik
segments.translation: And gatherest me with the people of Your tribulation

segments.arabic: وَفَرَّقْتَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ أَحِبَّائِكَ وَأَوْلِيَائِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa far-raq-ta bay-ni wa bay-na ahib-ba-ika wa aw-li-ya-ik
segments.translation: And separatest me from Your friends and saints,

segments.arabic: فَهَبْنِي يَا إِلَهِي وَسَيِّدِي وَمَوْلاي وَرَبِّي صَبَرْتُ عَلَى عَذَابِكَ،
segments.transliteration: fa-hab-ni ya ilahi wasay-yidi wa mawlaya wa rab-bi sabar-tu `ala `adhabika
segments.translation: Then suppose, My God, my Master, my Protector and my Lord that I am able to endure Your chastisement,

segments.arabic: فَكَيْفَ أَصْبِرُ عَلَى فِرَاقِكَ
segments.translation: How can I endure separation from You?

segments.arabic: وَهَبْنِي صَبَرْتُ عَلَى حَرِّ نَارِكَ،
segments.translation: And suppose that I am able to endure the heat of Your fire,

segments.arabic: فَكَيْفَ أَصْبِرُ عَنِ النَّظَرِ إِلَى كَرَامَتِكَ
segments.translation: How can I endure not gazing upon Your generosity?

segments.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ أَسْكُنُ فِي النَّارِ وَرَجَائِي عَفْوُكَ
segments.transliteration: am kayfa as-kunu fin-nari wa raja-i `af-wuk
segments.translation: Or how can I dwell in the Fire while my hope is Your pardon?

segments.arabic: فَبِعِزَّتِكَ يَا سَيِّدِي وَمَوْلاي أُقْسِمُ صَادِقاً، لَئِن تَرَكْتَنِي نَاطِقاً
segments.transliteration: fabi-i'z-zatika ya say-yidi wa mawlaya uq-simu sadiqal-la-in tarak-tani natiqan
segments.translation: So by Your might, my Master and my protector, I swear sincerely, if You leavest me with speech,

segments.arabic: لأَضِجَّنَّ إِلَيْكَ بَيْنَ أَهْلِهَا ضَجِيجَ الآمِلِينَ
segments.translation: I will lament to You from the midst of the Fire's inhabitants with lamentation of the hopeful;

segments.arabic: وَلأَصْرُخَنَّ إِلَيكَ صُرَاخَ المُسْتَصْرِخِينَ
segments.translation: I will cry to You with the cry of those crying for help;

segments.arabic: وَلأَبْكِيَنَّ عَلَيْكَ بُكَاءَ الفَاقِدِينَ
segments.translation: I will weep to You with the weeping of the bereft;

segments.arabic: وَلأُنَادِيَنَّكَ أَيْنَ كُنتَ يَا وَلِيَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa la-unadi-yan-naka ay-na kun-ta ya wali-yal-mu-minin
segments.translation: And I will call to You, Where art You, O Sponsor of the believers,

segments.arabic: يَا غَايَةَ آمَاِل العَارِفِينَ
segments.translation: O Goal of the hopes of Your knowers,

segments.arabic: يَا غِيَاثَ المُسْتَغِيثِينَ
segments.translation: O Aid of those who seek assistance,

segments.arabic: يَا حَبِيبَ قُلُوبِ الصَّادِقِينَ
segments.translation: O Friend of the hearts of the sincere

segments.arabic: وَيَا إِلَهَ العَالَمِينَ
segments.translation: And O God of all the world's inhabitants!

segments.arabic: أَفَتُرَاكَ، سُبْحَانَكَ يَا إِلَهِي وَبِحَمْدِكَ، تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا صَوْتَ عَبْدٍ مُّسْلِمٍ
segments.transliteration: afaturaka sub-hanaka ya ilahi wa biham-dika tas-mau' fiha saw-ta `ab-dim-mus-limin
segments.translation: Canst You see Yourself — Glory be to You My God, and Thine is the praised — hearing within the Fire the voice of a slave surrendered to You,

segments.arabic: سُجِنَ فِيهَا بِمُخَالَفَتِهِ
segments.translation: Imprisoned there because of his violations,

segments.arabic: وَذَاقَ طَعْمَ عَذَابِهَا بِمَعْصِيَتِهِ
segments.translation: Tasting the favour of its torment because of his disobedience,

segments.arabic: وَحُبِسَ بَيْنَ أَطْبَاقِهَا بِجُرْمِهِ وَجَرِيرَتِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa hubisa bayna at-baqiha bijur-mih wa jariratih
segments.translation: And confined within its levels because of his sin and crime,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ يَضِجُّ إلَيْكَ ضَجِيجَ مُؤَمِّلٍ لِّرَحْمَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa huwa yadij-ju ilayka dajija muammilil-lirah-mat-k
segments.translation: While he laments to You with the lament of one hopeful for Your mercy,

segments.arabic: وَيُنَادِيكَ بِلِسَانِ أَهْلِ تَوْحِيدِكَ
segments.translation: And calls to You with the tongue of those who profess Your Unity

segments.arabic: وَيَتَوَسَّلُ إلَيْكَ بِرُبُوبِيَّتِكَ
segments.translation: And entreats You by Your lordship!

segments.arabic: يَا مَوْلاي فَكَيْفَ يَبقَى فِي الْعَذَابِ وَهُوَ يَرْجُو مَا سَلَفَ مِنْ حِلْمِكَ
segments.transliteration: ya mawlay fa-kayfa yabqa fil-`adhabi wa huwa yar-ju ma salafa min hil-mik
segments.translation: My Protector, so how should he remain in the chastisement, while he has hope for Your previous clemency?

segments.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ تُؤْلِمُهُ النَّارُ وَهُوَ يَامَلُ فَضْلَكَ وَرَحْمَتَكَ
segments.transliteration: am kayfa tu-limuhun-naru wa huwa ya-malu fadlaka wa rah-mataka
segments.translation: Or how should the Fire cause him pain while he expects Your bounty and mercy?

segments.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ يُحْرِقُهُ لَهِيبُهَا وَأَنتَ تَسْمَعُ صَوْتَهُ وَتَرَى مَكَانَهُ
segments.transliteration: am kayfa yuh-riquhu lahibuha wa anta tas-mau' saw-tahu wa tara makanah
segments.translation: Or how should its flames burn him, while You hearest his voice and seest his place?

segments.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ يَشْتَمِلُ عَلَيْهِ زَفِيرُهَا وَأَنتَ تَعْلَمُ ضَعْفَهُ
segments.transliteration: am kayfa yash-tamilu `ailayhi zafiruha wa anta ta`lamu da`fah
segments.translation: Or how should its groaning encompass him, while You knowest his weakness?

segments.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ يَتَقَلْقَلُ بَيْنَ أَطْبَاقِهَا وَأَنتَ تَعْلَمُ صِدْقَهُ
segments.transliteration: am kayfa yataqalqalu bayna at-baqiha wa anta ta`lamu sid-qah
segments.translation: Or how should he be convulsed among its levels, while You knowest his sincerity?

segments.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ تَزْجُرُهُ زَبَانِيَتُهَا وَهُوَ يُنَادِيكَ يَا رَبَّهُ
segments.transliteration: am kayfa tazjuruhu zabani-yatuha wa huwa yunadika ya rab-bah
segments.translation: Or how should its keepers torture him while he calls out to You, O Lord?

segments.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ يَرْجُو فَضْلَكَ فِي عِتْقِهِ مِنْهَا فَتَتْرُكُهُ فِيهَا
segments.transliteration: am kayfa yar-ju fadlaka fi i't-qihi minha fatat-rukuhu fiha
segments.translation: Or how should he have hope of Your bounty in freeing him from it, while You abandonest him within it?

segments.arabic: هَيهَاتَ مَا ذَلِكَ الظَّنُّ بِكَ
segments.translation: Far be it from You! That is not what is expected of You,

segments.arabic: وَلا الْمَعْرُوفُ مِن فَضْلِكَ
segments.translation: Nor what is well-known of Your bounty,

segments.arabic: وَلا مُشْبِهٌ لِمَا عَامَلْتَ بِهِ الْمُوَحِّدِينَ مِنْ بِرِّكَ وَإِحْسَانِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa-la mush-biha lima `amal-ta bihil-muah-hidina mim bir-rika wa ih-sanik
segments.translation: Nor it is similar to the goodness and kindness You hast shown to those who profess Your Unity.

segments.arabic: فَبِالْيَقِينِ أَقْطَعُ لَوْلا مَا حَكَمْتَ بِهِ مِن تَعْذِيبِ جَاحِدِيكَ
segments.transliteration: fa-bial-yaqini aq-tau' law-la ma hakam-ta bihi min ta`dhibi jahidik
segments.translation: So I declare with certainty that were it not for what You hast decreed concerning the chastisement of Your deniers

segments.arabic: وَقَضَيْتَ بِهِ مِنْ إِخْلاَدِ مُعَانِدِيكَ
segments.transliteration: wa qadayta bihi min ikh-laydi mu`anidik
segments.translation: And what You hast foreordained concerning the everlasting home of those who stubbornly resist,

segments.arabic: لَجَعَلْتَ النَّارَ كُلَّهَا بَرْداً وَّسَلاَماً،
segments.translation: You wouldst make the Fire, all of it, coolness and safety,

segments.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لأَحَدٍ فِيهَا مَقَرّاً وَّلا مُقَاماً
segments.transliteration: wa ma kana li-ahadin fiha maqar-raw-wa-la muqama
segments.translation: And no one would have a place of rest or abode within it.

segments.arabic: لَّكِنَّكَ تَقَدَّسَتْ أَسْمَاؤُكَ أَقْسَمْتَ أَنْ تَمْلأَهَا مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ،
segments.transliteration: lakin-naka taqad-dasat as-ma-uka aq-sam-ta an tam-laha minal-kafirina;
segments.translation: But You—holy are Your Names—hast sworn that You wilt fill it with the unbelievers,

segments.arabic: مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
segments.translation: Both Jinn and men together,

segments.arabic: وَأَن تُخَلِّدَ فِيهَا الْمُعَانِدِينَ
segments.translation: And that You wilt place those who stubbornly resist therein forever.

segments.arabic: وَأَنتَ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ قُلْتَ مُبْتَدَئاً، وَّتَطَوَّلْتَ بِالإِنْعَامِ مُتَكَرِّماً:
segments.transliteration: wa anta jal-la thana-uka qul-ta mub-tadiwaw-wa tataw-wal-ta bil-in-`ami mutakar-rima
segments.translation: And You— majestic is Your eulogy— said at the beginning and wernt gracious through kindness as a favour,

segments.arabic: أَفَمَن كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَن كَانَ فَاسِقًا ۚ لَّا يَسْتَوُونَ
segments.transliteration: afaman kana muminan kaman kana fasiqal-la yas-tawun
segments.translation: (What? Is he who has been believer like unto him who has been ungodly? They are not equal)

segments.arabic: إِلَهِي وَسَيِّدِي فَأَسْألُكَ بِالْقُدْرَةِ الَّتِي قَدَّرْتَهَا
segments.transliteration: ilahi wa say-yidi fa-as-aluka bial-qud-ratil-lati qad-dartaha
segments.translation: My God and my Master! So I ask You by the power You hast apportioned

segments.arabic: وَبِالْقَضِيَّةِ الَّتِي حَتَمْتَهَا وَحَكَمْتَهَا وَغَلَبْتَ مَنْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرَيْتَهَا
segments.transliteration: wa bil-qadi-yatil-lati hatam-taha wa hakam-taha wa ghalab-ta man `ailayhi aj-raytaha
segments.translation: And by the decision which You hast determined and imposed and through which You hast overcome him toward whom it has been put into effect,

segments.arabic: أَن تَهَبَ لِي، فِي هذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ، وَفِي هَذِهِ السَّاعَةِ
segments.transliteration: an tahaba li fi hadhihil-laylati wa fi hadhihis-sa'ah
segments.translation: That You forgivest me in this night and at this hour

segments.arabic: كُلَّ جُرْمٍ أَجْرَمْتُهُ
segments.translation: Every offence I have committed,

segments.arabic: وَكُلَّ ذَنْبٍ أَذْنَبْتُهُ
segments.translation: And every sin I have performed,

segments.arabic: وَكُلَّ قَبِيحٍ أَسْرَرْتُهُ
segments.translation: And every ugly thing I have concealed

segments.arabic: وَكُلَّ جَهْلٍ عَمِلْتُهُ،
segments.translation: And every folly I have enacted

segments.arabic: كَتَمْتُهُ أَوْ أَعْلَنتُهُ،
segments.translation: Whether I have hidden or announced it,

segments.arabic: أَخفَيْتُهُ أَوْ أَظْهَرْتُهُ
segments.translation: Or I have concealed it or manifested it

segments.arabic: وَكُلَّ سَيِّئَةٍ أَمَرْتَ بِإِثْبَاتِهَا الْكِرَامَ الكَاتِبِينَ
segments.translation: And every evil act which You hast commanded the Noble Writers to record,

segments.arabic: الَّذِينَ وَكَّلْتَهُم بِحِفْظِ مَا يَكُونُ مِنِّي
segments.transliteration: al-ladhina wak-kal-tahum bi-hif-zi ma yakunu min-ni
segments.translation: Those whom You hast appointed to watch over what appears from me

segments.arabic: وَجَعَلْتَهُمْ شُهُوداً عَلَيَّ مَعَ جَوَارِحِي،
segments.translation: And whom You hast made, along with my bodily members, witness against me.

segments.arabic: وَكُنتَ أَنتَ الرَّقِيبَ عَلَيَّ مِن وَّرَائِهِمْ،
segments.translation: And You wast Yourself the Watcher over me from behind them,

segments.arabic: وَالشَّاهِدَ لِمَا خَفِي عَنْهُمْ،
segments.translation: And the Witness of what is hidden from them

segments.arabic: وَبِرَحْمَتِكَ أَخْفَيْتَهُ،
segments.translation: But through Your mercy You concealed it

segments.arabic: وَبفَضْلِكَ سَتَرْتَهُ
segments.translation: And through Your bounty You veiled it.

segments.arabic: وَأَن تُوَفِّرَ حَظِّي مِن كُلِّ خَيْرٍ تُنْزِلُهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa an tuwf-fira haz-zi min kul-li khayrin tunziluh
segments.translation: [And I ask You] that You bestowest upon me an abundant share of every good You sendest down,

segments.arabic: أَوْ إِحْسَانٍ تُفْضِلُهُ
segments.translation: Or kindness You conferrest,

segments.arabic: أَوْ بِرٍّ تَنْشِرُهُ،
segments.translation: Or goodness You unfoldest,

segments.arabic: أَوْ رِزْقٍ تَبْسُطُهُ
segments.translation: Or provision You spreadest out,

segments.arabic: أَوْ ذَنْبٍ تَغْفِرُهُ
segments.translation: Or sin You forgivest,

segments.arabic: أَوْ خَطَأٍ تَسْتُرُهُ
segments.translation: Or error You coverest.

segments.arabic: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ
segments.transliteration: ya rab-bi ya rab-bi ya rabb
segments.translation: My Lord! My Lord! My Lord!

segments.arabic: يَا إِلَهِي وَسَيِّدِي وَمَوْلاي وَمَاِلكَ رِقِّي
segments.transliteration: ya ilahi wa say-yidi wa maw-laya wa malika riq-qi
segments.translation: My God! My Master! My Protector! Owner of my bondage!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ بِيَدِهِ نَاصِيَتِي
segments.translation: O He in whose hand is my forelock!

segments.arabic: يَا عَلِيماً بِضُرِّي وَمَسْكَنَتِي
segments.translation: O He who knows my affliction and my misery!

segments.arabic: يَا خَبِيراً بِفَقْرِي وَفَاقَتِي
segments.translation: O He who is aware of my poverty and indigence!

segments.arabic: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ
segments.transliteration: ya rab-bi ya ya rab-bi ya rabb
segments.translation: My Lord! My Lord! My Lord!

segments.arabic: أَسْألُكَ بِحَقِّكَ وَقُدْسِكَ
segments.translation: I ask You by Your Truth and Your Holiness

segments.arabic: وَأَعْظَمِ صِفَاتِكَ وَأَسْمَائِكَ
segments.translation: And the greatest of Your Attributes and Names,

segments.arabic: أن تَجْعَلَ أَوْقَاتِي فِي اللَّيلِ وَالنَّهَارِ بِذِكْرِكَ مَعْمُورَةً،
segments.transliteration: an taj-`ala aw-qati fil-layli wan-nahari bi-dhik-rika ma`murah
segments.translation: That You makest my times in the night and the day inhabited by Your remembrance,

segments.arabic: وَبِخِدْمَتِكَ مَوْصُولَةً،
segments.translation: And joined to Your service

segments.arabic: وَّأَعْمَاِلي عِنْدَكَ مَقْبُولَةً،
segments.translation: And my works acceptable to You,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى تَكُونَ أَعْمَاِلي وَأَوْرَادِي كُلُّهَا وِرْداً وَّاحِداً،
segments.transliteration: hat-ta takuna a`mali wa aw-radi kul-luha wir-daw-wahidan
segments.translation: So that my works and my litanies may all be a single litany

segments.arabic: وَّحَاِلي فِي خِدْمَتِكَ سَرْمَداً
segments.translation: And my occupation with Your service everlasting.

segments.arabic: يَا سَيِّدِي، يَا مَنْ عَلَيْهِ مُعَوَّلِي
segments.translation: My Master! O He upon whom I depend!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ إلَيْهِ شَكَوْتُ أَحْوَاِلي
segments.translation: O He to whom I complain about my states!

segments.arabic: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ
segments.transliteration: ya rab-bi ya rab-bi ya rabb
segments.translation: My Lord! My Lord! My Lord!

segments.arabic: قَوِّ عَلَى خِدْمَتِكَ جَوَارِحِي
segments.translation: Strengthen my bodily members in Your service,

segments.arabic: وَاشْدُدْ عَلىَ الْعَزِيمَةِ جَوَانِحِي
segments.translation: And fortify my ribs in determination

segments.arabic: وَهَبْ لِي الْجِدَّ فِي خَشْيَتِكَ
segments.translation: And bestow upon me earnestness in my fear of You

segments.arabic: وَالدَّوَامَ فِي الإتِّصَاِل بِخِدْمَتِكَ
segments.translation: And continuity in my being joined to Your service

segments.arabic: حَتَّى أَسْرَحَ إِلَيكَ فِي مَيَادِينِ السَّابِقِينَ
segments.translation: So that I may move easily toward You in the battlefields of the foremost

segments.arabic: وَأُسْرِعَ إلَيْكَ فِي الْمبُادِرِينَ
segments.translation: And hurry to You among the prominent

segments.arabic: وَأَشْتَاقَ إلىَ قُرْبِكَ فِي الْمُشْتَاقِينَ
segments.translation: And desire fervently Your proximity among the fervently desirous

segments.arabic: وَأَدْنُوَ مِنْكَ دُنُوَّ الْمُخْلِصِينَ
segments.translation: And move nearer to You with the nearness of the sincere

segments.arabic: وَأَخَافَكَ مَخَافَةَ الْمُوقِنِينَ
segments.translation: And fear You with the fear of those who have certitude

segments.arabic: وَأَجْتَمِعَ فِي جِوَارِكَ مَعَ الْمُؤْمنِينَ
segments.translation: And gather with the believers in Your vicinity.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَمَنْ أَرَادَنِي بِسُوٍء فَأَرِدْهُ
segments.transliteration: allahumma wa man aradani bisuo-in farid-hu
segments.translation: O Allah, whoever desires evil for me, desire [it] for him!

segments.arabic: وَمَن كَادَنِي فَكِدْهُ
segments.translation: whoever deceives me-deceive him!

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ أَحَسَنِ عَبِيدِكَ نَصِيباً عِنْدَكَ
segments.translation: And make me one of the most excellent of Your slaves in Portion from You,

segments.arabic: وَأَقْرَبِهِم مَّنْزِلَةً مِّنْكَ
segments.translation: And the nearest of them in station to You

segments.arabic: وَأَخَصِّهِمْ زُلْفَةً لَّديْكَ
segments.translation: And the most elected of them in proximity to You.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ لا يُنَالُ ذَلِكَ إِلاَّ بِفَضْلِكَ
segments.transliteration: fa-in-nahu la yunalu dha-lika il-la bi-fadlik
segments.translation: For that cannot be attained except by Your bounty.

segments.arabic: وَجُدْ لِي بِجُودِكَ
segments.translation: And grant generously to me through Your munificence,

segments.arabic: وَاعْطِفْ عَلَيَّ بِمَجْدِكَ
segments.translation: And incline toward me with Your splendour

segments.arabic: وَاحْفَظْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ
segments.translation: And protect me with Your mercy!

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَل لِّسَانِي بِذِكْرِكَ لَهِجاً
segments.translation: And make my tongue remember You without ceasing

segments.arabic: وَّقَلْبِي بِحُبِّكَ مُتَيَّماً
segments.translation: And my heart enthralled by Your love!

segments.arabic: وَّمُنَّ عَلَيَّ بِحُسْنِ إِجَابَتِكَ
segments.translation: And be gracious to me by answering me favourably,

segments.arabic: وَأَقِلْنِي عَثْرَتِي
segments.translation: And nullify my slips

segments.arabic: وَاغْفِرْ زَلَّتِي
segments.translation: And forgive my lapses!

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّكَ قَضَيْتَ عَلَى عِبَادِكَ بِعِبَادَتِكَ
segments.translation: For You hast decreed Your worship for Your servants

segments.arabic: وَأَمَرْتَهُم بِدُعَائِكَ
segments.translation: And commanded them to supplicate You

segments.arabic: وَضَمِنتَ لَهُمُ الإِجَابَةَ
segments.translation: And assured them that they would be answered.

segments.arabic: فَإِلَيْكَ يَا رَبِّ نَصَبْتُ وَجْهِي
segments.translation: So toward You, my Lord, I have turned my face

segments.arabic: وَإلَيْكَ يَا رَبِّ مَدَدتُّ يَدِي
segments.transliteration: wa ilayka ya rab-bi madad-tu yadi
segments.translation: And toward You, my Lord, I have extended my hand.

segments.arabic: فَبِعِزَّتِكَ اسْتَجِبْ لِي دُعَائِي
segments.translation: So by Your might, comply with my supplication

segments.arabic: وَبَلِّغْنِي مُنَاي
segments.translation: And make me attain my desires!

segments.arabic: وَلا تَقْطَعْ مِن فَضْلِكَ رَجَائِي
segments.translation: Do not severe my hoping for Your Favours

segments.arabic: وَاكْفِنِي شَرَّ الْجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ مِنْ أَعْدَائِي
segments.translation: And spare me the evil of my enemies from among the jinn and men!

segments.arabic: يَا سَرِيعَ الرِّضَا
segments.translation: O He, whose pleasure is quickly achieved!

segments.arabic: اغْفِرْ لِمَن لا يَمْلِكُ إِلاَّ الدُّعَاءَ
segments.translation: Forgive him who owns nothing but supplication

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا تَشَاءُ
segments.translation: For You dost what You wilt.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ اسْمُهُ دَوَاءٌ
segments.translation: O He whose Name is a remedy,

segments.arabic: وَذِكْرُهُ شِفَاءٌ
segments.translation: And whose remembrance is a cure,

segments.arabic: وَطَاعَتُهُ غِنًى
segments.translation: And whose obedience is wealth!

segments.arabic: ارْحَم مَّن رَّأْسُ مَاِلهِ الرَّجَاءُ
segments.translation: Have mercy upon him whose capital is hope

segments.arabic: وَسِلاَحُهُ الْبُكَاءُ
segments.translation: And whose weapon is tears!

segments.arabic: يَا سَاِبغَ النِّعَمِ
segments.translation: O Ample in blessings!

segments.arabic: يَا دَافِعَ النِّقَمِ
segments.translation: O Repeller of adversities!

segments.arabic: يَا نُورَ الْمُسْتَوْحِشِينَ فِي الظُّلَمِ
segments.translation: O Light of those who are lonely in the darkness!

segments.arabic: يَا عَالِماً لا يُعَلَّمُ
segments.translation: O Knower who was never taught!

Send blessing, peace and increase Your mercy on the purified master, the successful leader, the brave lion, the father of Hasan and Husein, the distributor of Paradise and Hell, who possess wide belly, strong and embolden, firm integrity, the obvious scholar, the helper and patron, the guardian of the Religion, the guardian of the guardians, the pleasant master, the leader of the executors, who judge with clear text of the Qur'an, who possess clear sincerity, who was buried in Garriy(The very place Imam Ali was buried in the holy city of Najaf), lion the son of the conqueror, the exterior of astonishment, the endorser of every stages, the separator of fashions, the penetrating star, the passive lion, the point of circle of request, the conqueror lion of God, the conqueror of every conqueror, the desire of every needier, the possessor of all pride and high rank, the leader of the east and west, our master and the master of the two worlds, the leader, father of the two Hasan, the commander of the faithful, Ali son of Abi Talib, may the blessing of Allah be on him.

Send blessing, peace and increase mercy on the splendid and beautiful princess, the infallible and the oppressed one, the noble and magnanimous one, the pleasant who has suffered a lot from the hand of the mischievous ones, who has long grief in a short period of time, the pleasant and tolerant, the modest and perfect, the one whose prestige was not known, who is having hidden grave, who was buried secretly, who was openly usurped, the mistress of the women, the most beautiful among human being, the mother of the excellent and noble leaders, daughter of the best among the Prophets, the pure and purified one, the virgin and maiden one, Fatimah the devout and bosom one, peace be on her.

Send Your blessing, peace and increase Your mercy on the caller to Prophet hood, the influence of the lion (Ali) the infallible of Fatimah, the tolerant of Al-Hasan, the braveness of Al-Husein, the worship of Al-Sajjad, the effects of Al-Baqir, the sign of Al-Ja'afar, the science of Al-Kazim, the proves of Rida, the openhandedness of Taqi, the purity of Naqi, the solemnity of Al-Askari, and the divine occultation, who shall stand with truth, who shall call for absolute truth, the word of Allah, the security of Allah, the proof of Allah, who was overcome with Allah's commandment, who dissolve in the scared of Allah, the open and hidden leader, the defender of tribulations and afflictions, the possessor of generosity and favour, the true Imam, Muhammad son of Al-Hasan, the father of Al-Qasim, the leader of the age and the time, the ambassador of the Most Merciful, the leader of men and Jinn, (may Allah's blessing and peace be upon him).

segments.translation:
O' my chiefs and masters, I have concentrated with you all, you are all my leaders and devices the day of my need, indigence and demands before Allah, I take you (all) as a means to Almighty Allah, with love and nearness to you (all) I hope for deliverance from Allah, you should act as my hope before Allah, O' my masters, O' the friends of Allah, may Allah's blessing be on you all.

O' Allah! These are our Imams, masters, leaders, elders, and intercessors, to them I gave allegiance and I denounce their enemies in this world and the world Hereafter.

O' Allah! Be in friend with those that paid them allegiance, and be in enmity with their enemies, help those that render assistance to them and let down those that betray them.

O' Allah! Curse those that oppress them, and hasten their relief and destroy their enemies among the Jinn and the men from the beginning to the end of the time, (Amen), O' the Lord of the worlds.O' Allah! Grant us the opportunity to visit them in this world and grant us their intercession in the world Hereafter, resurrect us within their group, and under their banner, O' Allah don't distinguish between us and them even in a twinkling of eye in this world and in the world Hereafter; with Your Mercy, O' the Most Mercy of the merciful.[1]

text: Dua Mashlool Ø¯Ø¹Ø§Ø¡ Ø§ÙÙ Ø´ÙÙÙ This du-a'a known as "supplication of the youth stricken for his sin," is quoted from the work of Kaf-ami and from Muhaj al Da-wat by Sayyid ibn Tawus. from Imam Ali ibn abi Talib(as) who wrote his dua'a and gave it to a paralized man instruction to recite after Isha salat Signifance of this Dua Signifance/Background of this Dua × This du-a'a known as "supplication of the youth stricken for his sin," is quoted from the work of Kaf-ami and from Muhaj al Da-wat by Sayyid ibn Tawus. Through Imam Hussain(as) it is reported that one day he and his father, after performing Hajj, caught sight of a paralysed young man crying his eyes out in repentance. They went near to console him and find out the reason of his sorry plight. He was a habitual sinner, always teased his father, disobeyed him and treated him with contempt. One day, disgusted, the father invoked curse upon him. So he was affected with paralysis. Then and there Imam Ali ibn abi Talib(as) wrote his dua'a and gave it to him with instruction to recite after Isha salat. Next day fully cured, he came to Imam Ali and said that he had recited the dua'a as told and went to sleep. He saw the Holy Prophet (sa) in the dream. The holy prophet, gently touched his body with his hand and asked him to remember this dua'a as it contain ismi azam (the great name of Allah). Recite this dua'a after Isha salat. It brings countless blessings. All your legitimate desires will be fulfilled. It drives away poverty and sickness. Sins are for given. Debts are cleared. Enemies become friends. Domestic affairs are set aright. Disputes are settled in your favour. Prisoners are set free mental worries disappear. Prosperity, sound mind and healthy body stand by you at all times. Mercy and forgiveness of sins are the main advantages the almighty Allah makes available if this dua'a is recited regularly. he effective prayer is undoubtedly an inspired work. Any one who is acquainted with the soul-stirring experience of great religious thoughts cannot help seeing in these immortal words of Hazrat Ali (as) the dazzling light of Universal Truth. × . segments.translation: O Allah, if I obey You, then the essence of praise is for You, and if I disobey You then the Proof is for You. From You is comfort and from You is success. Glory be to the one who has bestowed favors and thanked. Glory be to the One who commanded and forgave. O Allah, if I am disobedient to you, then I indeed I have also obeyed You in those matters that You prefer most, and it is belief (faith) in You. I have not taken for You any son and neither have I considered anyone Your partner even then the favor is from you upon me and there is no favor from me upon You. Also I have indeed disobeyed You O My Allah, this disobedience was not due to pride or due to leaving Your worship or due to the denial of Allah. segments.translation: O One Who is safe from everything and everything is fearful of Him. I ask in the name of this safety and in the name of the fearfulness of everything that You bless Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad and accord me safety in my self, my family and my children, so in me also no fear remains of anything, ever. You are powerful over everything and Allah is sufficient for us and the best of the executors. O one who sufficed for Ibrahim against Nimrod and sufficed for Musa against Pharaoh. I beseech You that You bless Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad and be sufficient for me against the mischief of the enemy. (Then soon Allah would prevent the mischief of one whose mischief one fears)

segments.transliteration:
wa as'alukallahumma bi haqqi waliyyika abi ja'farinil jawaad,
muhammadibni 'aliyyin 'alayhis salaam,
illa judta 'alayya bihi min fadhlik,  wa tafadh-dhalta 'alayya bihi min wus'ik,
maa astaghni bihi 'ammaa fi aydi khalqik,
wa khaassatan ya rabbi li'aamihim
wa baarik lee feehi wa fee ma laka 'indee min ni'amika wa fadhlika wa rizqik.
ilaahi anqata'ar rajaa'u illa mink,  wa khaabatil aamaalu illa feek,
ya dhal jalaali wal ikraam,
as'aluka bihaqqi man haqquhu 'alayka waajibun
an tusalliya 'ala muhammadin wa ahli baytihi
wa an tabsuta 'alayya maa khatartahu min rizqik
wa an tusahhila dhaalika wa tuyassirahu fee khayrin minka wa 'aafiyatin
wa ana fee khaffadhi 'aiyshin wa da'a   ya arhamar rahimeen
segments.translation: O Allah, O the cause of one for whom there is no cause, O cause of all that have cause. O cause of causes in that where there is no cause. Bless Muhammad and the progeny of Muhammad. Make me needless through Your permissible from Your prohibited. And through Your obedience from Your disobedience and by Your Grace from others than You. O the Living, O the Everlasting.[11]

text: Duas for Rizq- Sustenance . Basics Baqiyatus-Salehat Sahifas-Other Misc Hadith/Actions Arabic Transliteration Translation Imam Ali(as) in 'Nahjulbalagha' on SUSTENANCE: Allah has guaranteed your livelihood and has commanded you to act. Therefore, the pursuit of that which has been guaranteed to you should not get preference over that whose performance has been enjoined upon you. But by Allah, most certainly the position is that doubt has overtaken and certainty has been shattered and it seems as if what has been guaranteed to you is obligatory on you and what was made obligatory on you has been taken away from you. So, hasten towards (good) actions and dread the suddenness of death, because the return of age cannot be hoped for, as the return of livelihood can be hoped for. Whatever is missed from livelihood today may be hoped tomorrow with increase, but whatever is lost from the age yesterday, its return cannot be expected today. Hope can be only for that which is to come, while about that which is passed there is only disappointment. So ";fear Allah as He ought to be feared and do not die until you are (true) Muslim."; (Qur'an , 3:102) 1. Reciting All Salat exactly on Time & following all HIS www.Islamic-laws.com increases Rizq Things that increase/decrease "Rizq " click here | Increasing Sustenance-Booklet 2. Tasbih of Fatima Zehra (sa) :- Once the Prophet's (saw) daughter Fatima Zehra (as) asked the prophet for a helper. The Prophet(saw) advised her to recite the Tasbih which is known as 'Tasbih e Zehra'. This Tasbih is usually recited after each obligatory salat. However it also has great value for solving the problems of Rizq, Sustenance, Business, Job etc. Recite the tasbih with the niyat (intention) of seeking rizq (sustenance) , before leaving the house ,before commencing business and before starting work at office. 34 times -Allah o Akbar, 33 times- Alhumdolillah & 33 times- Subhanallah 3. Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq (as) said:âOne who is busy in recitations after Morning Namaz till the sun rises is more successful in acquiring sustenance than through business for a whole monthâ -Reference: Makarimul Akhlaq, Pg. 304; 4. Tawasul of lady Khadija(sa): Seek intercession from her to overcome Rizq problems as her wealth made the Prophet (saws) wealthy 5. Saying Salam upon entering home A person came to the Prophet (saws.) and complained of poverty and straitening of sustenance. The Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.s.) told him: When you enter your house, say 'Salam' whether there is someone therein or not. Then recite Surah Tawheed, once. The man did as advised and Allah gave him so much that he even passed some of it to his neighbors.[8] Tibb al-Aaimma, As-Sayyid Shubbar, Pg. 524 6. Dua NE'MUL Badal Lady Umme Salma was widowed in Madina and in difficulty when she requested the Holy Prophet (saws) for a Dua. The Prophet (saws) asked her to recite the following Dua: As a consequence of reciting this dua, she became the wife of the Holy Prophet (saws) when she had no hope of earning respect and a decent living. segments.translation: 113 - Oh God, I ask you, by the right of your guardian, Muhammad ibn Ali, to be gracious to me by your grace and to be generous with him and to be generous to me. Your sustenance, and make what you have permitted sufficient for your forbidden, and you have made it for me to you, for you can do whatever you wish.

From whomever You will, and You honor whomever You will, and You abase whomever You will. In Your hand is all good. Indeed, You are over all things competent. You merge the night into the day, and You merge the day into the night, and You bring the living out of the dead, and You bring the dead out of the living, and You provide for whomever You will without account.

O Most Merciful of this world and the Hereafter, and Most Merciful of them.
You give from them whomever You wish and withhold from them whomever You wish. Bless Muhammad and his family and clear my debt from me.

115 - Oh God, I ask you, O there is no god but You, in truth.There is no god but You, to have mercy on me, there is no god but You, O God, I ask you, there is no god but You, truly, there is no god but You, to be satisfied with me There is no god but You, O God, I ask you, there is no god but You, by the truth, there is no god but You, to forgive me, there is no god but You.
117 - There is no god but You, Glory be to You. Indeed, I was one of The oppressors -

119 - O Lord, the eyes have fallen asleep and the stars have set, and You are the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining. Drowsiness and sleep do not overtake You. Neither a dark night nor a resting land nor a deep sea nor layers of darkness, one above another, will be hidden from You. O Hearer of the clear cry of the righteous and O Helper of those who seek Your mercy, I seek help, so bless Muhammad and his family and decide for me. In need, and do not send me back disappointed or deprived, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

segments.transliteration: allaahumma aatinee bin a'afiyati min h'aythu shi-ta wa kayfa shi-ta wa annaa shi-ta fa-innaka taf-a'lu maa shi-ta kayfa shi-ta
segments.translation:
O Allah, verily You, unto those who love You, are more loving than any who loves; You are ever at hand to fulfill atonce the desires of those who rely on You; You take notice of their wishes, You perceive their innermost thoughts, You know the depth of their intelligence. You are fully aware of their confidential concerns. There hearts long for (relief from) You. Whenever miserable and forsaken Your remembrance comfort them in distress. Whenever misfortunes assult them, they turn to You, knowing well that the reins of all affairs are in Your hand and every affair rise from and flow out as soon as Your decision is made. O my Allah, if I falter in speaking my request and wander astray in describing my needs and wants, show me the way that leads to that which promotes my interests and turn my heart to its course, because it is neither against (the principles of) Your guidance nor Your act of giving succour can be described as unlikely.

Certainly You are All-Kind and All-Merciful.[3]

segments.transliteration: bismil laahe kharajto wa bismil laahe walajto wa aâlal laahe tawakkalto wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa bil-laahil aâliyyil aâzeem.
segments.translation:
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

O Allah! My many sins have made me lose face before You, prevented me from being worthy of Your mercy, and kept me away from deserving Your forgiveness! I have adhered to Your boons and clung to supplicating You, for You have promised those who are like me in acting extravagantly (against their own souls), making errors, and despairing of Your mercy through Your words: âSay: O My servants who have acted extravagantly against their own souls, do not despair of the mercy of Allah; surely Allah forgives the faults altogether; surely He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.â[9] You have warned those who despair of Your mercy and said: âAnd who despairs of the mercy of his Lord but the erring ones.â[10] Then You have summoned us through Your mercy to supplicate You, thus You have said: âCall upon me, I will answer you; surely those who are too proud for My mercy shall soon enter hell abased.â[11] O my Lord! Hopelessness has covered me, and despair of Your mercy has wrapped me! O my Lord! You have promised to reward him who has good opinion in You and to punish him who has bad opinion in You! O Allah! My eye has been seized by good opinion of You in releasing my neck from the Fire, covering my slips, releasing (me) from my stumble! O Allah! Your words, which have neither alteration nor change, are true: â(Remember) the day when We will call every people with their Imam.â[12] That is the Day of Resurrection when the trumpet shall be blown and âwhat is in the graves shall be raised.â[13] O Allah! I believe, witness, confess, do not deny, do not renege, conceal, announce, manifest, and hide that You are Allah, there is no god but You, One with no partner with You, that Muhammad is Your servant and messenger, may Allah bless him and his Family, and that Ali, the Commander of the faithful, master of the testamentary trustees, inheritor of knowledge of the prophets, emblem of religion, destroyer of the hypocrites, the fighter against the Renegades (Maareqeen), my Imam, my proof, my handle, my path, my guide, and my argument. I do not trust my deeds though pure; nor do I see that they will save me though righteous but through (showing) friendship to him, following his example, acknowledging his great virtues, accepting from those who delivered them, and submitting to those who narrated them. I confess that his testamentary trustees from among his grandsons are Imams, arguments, guides, lamps, guideposts, lighthouses, masters, and pious. I believe in their secret, their openness, their outward, their inward, their present, their absent, their living, and their dead. In that there is neither doubt nor suspicion nor change when You turn away (from that). O Allah! summon me on the day of my mustering and my resurrecting through their Imamate, and save me, O My Master! From the heat of the Fires through them, and supply me with the repose of the Gardens! Surely, if You release me from the Fire, I will be one of the achievers. O Allah! I rose in the morning of this day of mine (while) I have neither confidence nor hope nor asylum nor place of flight nor shelter except those through whom I seek access to You, seeking nearness to Your Messenger Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Family, then Ali, the Commander of the faithful, al-Zahra, the mistress of the women of the worlds, al-Hasan, al-Husain, Ali, Muhammad, Jaâfar, Moosa, Ali, Muhammad, Ali, al-Hasan and the one after them who will pave the way for the hidden proof from among his children, hoped for the community after him. O Allah! Make them in this day and after it my fortress against detested things and my stronghold against fears; save me through them from every enemy, tyrant, oppressor, sinner, the evil of what I know, what I deny, what has hidden from me, what I see, and the evil of every crawling creature that You have taken by the forelock! Surely You are on a straight path. O Allah! Through my seeking access through them to You, seeking nearness to You through showing love for them, fortifying myself with their Imamate, open for me the doors to Your provision; spread upon me Your mercy; make Your creatures love me; turn me aside from their detest and their enmity! Verily You are powerful over everything. O Allah! There is reward for everyone (who) seek access (through them to You); there is right for all the possessors of intercession, hence by him whom You have appointed as Your friend and placed ahead my request, I ask You to make me recognize the blessing of this day of mine, this month of mine, and this year of mine! O Allah! They are my place of flight and my help during my hardship, my ease, my well-being, my tribulation, my sleep, my wakefulness, my departure, my residence, my difficulty, my facility, my openness, my secret, my morning, my evening, my movement, my habitation, my secret, and my apparent! O Allah! Through them, disappoint me not of Your favor; cut not my hope from Your mercy; disappoint me not of Your repose; tempt me not with the closure of the doors to provisions and of the ways to them; open for me an easy opening from You; appoint for me a way out from every hardship and a road for every plenty! Surely, You are the Most Merciful of the merciful. May Allah bless Muhammad and his good and pure Household! Amen, Lord of the worlds![14]

text: Seeking Forgiveness - Isteghfar - Tawbah- Repentance Importance Significance × stighfaar means seeking forgiveness of Allah for the sins so far committed and turning repentant unto Allah. Ibn Abbas relates that the was in the company of Imam Ali(as) when a man came and said Mawla, I have transgressed much "Imam told him: ISTIGHFAAR. Another man came and said : Mawla my land has become arid and parched, what shall I do ?. Imam told him ISTIGHFAR. After a few moments another came and said Mawla I am poverty stricken. Nothing I do bearts fruit. Is there any remedy. Imam said: ISTIGHFAR. Then another man came and said : Mawla Allah has not yet blessed me with a child. What should I do. Imam told him ISTIGHAFAR. I asked him : O AMIRUL MUMININ - though the problems were different, but to each of them you advised to pray ISTIGHFAAR. Imam said : Because Allah says in surah Nuh: And I said : seek forgiveness of your Lord. Verily he is ever most forgiving. He will send you abundant rain from the heaven and will help you with wealth and sons, and will make for you gardens and will make for your rivers. Imam Mohammed Taqi Al Jawad (as) :"Touba" depends upon four things: sincere regrets, verbal "istighfar", deeds and determination never to repeat the sin. O you who believe! turn (in repentance) to Allah a sincere turning; May be your Lord will remove from you your evilÃ¯Â¿Â½ (Qur'an, 66: 8) Said the Prophet of Allah (s): There are four signs of a repentant: 1) He is sincere to God in his actions 2) He shuns falsehood 3) He attaches firmly to truth and 4) He is eager to do good.[Al-Harani, Tohaf al-Uqool, p. 20] Imam JaÃ¯Â¿Â½far al-Sadiq (a) said: 'When a servant turns to God with sincere repentance (tawbatan nasuhan), God loves him and covers him (i.e. his sins) in the world and the Hereafter.' I said, 'And how does He cover him? 'The Imam (a) replied, "He makes the two angels (assigned to write his deeds) forget that which they have writÃ¯Â¿Â½ten of his sins. Then He inspires his bodily members (saying), "Do conceal his sins," and He inspires the earth's places (saying), "Conceal the sins that he used to commit over you." Then he meets God, at the time that he meets Him, in such a manner that there is nothing to give witness against him regarding any sin." × . Eighth: DUA'A 23 Imam Jafar bin Muhammad as Sadiq said: 1) He who has intended to do good but could not, is credited with the good in his record of good deeds. 2) He who intends to do good and actually does so will receive tenfold of reward determined for that one good deed. 3) He who intends to do wrong but does not put it into practice will not be asked for any explanation. (4) He who intends to do evil and actually does so, has an hour at his disposal to turn repentant unto Allah. The angel who records good deeds asks the angel who records evil deeds to wait. May be the sinner does a good deed which wipes out the evil deed done by him. Verily good deeds take away evil deeds. If he repents and recites the following istighfar his sin will not be recorded. Extract Isteaaza Dastaghaib shirazi Satan strives hard to find a place in the heart of a momin. It is narrated that even if a momin escapes unscathed from the trap of Satan because his good deeds ninety nine times, he might become the victim on hundredth attempt! It is quite possible that the instigation for the gou deeds ninety nine times too was by Satan only to make the pen complacent that he fell into the trap on the hundredth attempt! The Satan derives satisfaction from destroying in one stroke the effects of good actions of the person spread over long period. The dividing in between the good and the evil is very narrow and one must take care not to falter towards evil. segments.translation: Praise be to Allah confessing to His bounties and there is no god except Allah with sincere belief in His Oneness. And bliss of Allah be on Muhammad the chief of the creatures and on his chosen ones from his progeny. So to say: among the bounties of Allah upon the mankind is that He made it needless with lawful from that which is unlawful. Thus, Allah, the Glorified and the High said: And marry those among you who are single and those who are fit among your male slaves and your female slaves; if they are needy, Allah will make them free from want out of His grace; and Allah is Ample-giving, Knowing. And the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.s.) said: âMarry and increase your population, for I will boast of my large Ummah on the Day of Judgment.â And he said: Nikah is from my Sunnah. Thus one who abandons my Sunnah is not from me. And may Allah bless Muhammad and the chaste and purified progeny.

Make them leaders guiding others by Your command to Your obedience (Q 21:72)
And let them command others to that which pleases You
O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.

And make him a goodly creation and do not make Satan a partner or shareholder in him. O Allah indeed I seek Your forgiveness and turn towards You. Indeed You are Forgiving, Merciful.

Then We made the seed a clot, then We made the clot a lump of flesh, then We made (in) the lump of flesh bones, then We clothed the bones with flesh, then We caused it to grow into another creation, so blessed be Allah, the best of the creators.[41] I stop the child of so and so, daughter of so and so, by Allah, the One who âHe withholds the heaven from falling on the earth except with His permission;â and by the power of Allah, âthe One Who upholds the heavens and the earth lest they come to naught.â

awlam yarallad'eena kafarooo annas samaawaati wal arz'a kaanataa ratqan fa-fataqnaaahumma wa ja-a'lnaa minal maaa-i kulla shay-in h'ayy a-falaa yoominoon wa aayatullahumul layl naslakhu minhun nahaara fa-id'aa hum muz'limoon

wa aayatul lahum annha h'amalnaa d'urriyyatahum fil fulkil mashh'oon wa khalaqna lahum mim mithlihee maa yarkaboon.

segments.translation:
O my Allah, do not leave me alone (childless), though You are the best of inheritors.
Sorrowfulness due to loneliness and sense of abandonment made me fall short of what I should have done to thank You, but (I beseech You to) give me an upright and honest posterity, male and female. On account of them change my loneliness with companionship and let there be ease and comfort instead of desolation, so that I should thank You on the completion of bounty, O the great, the giver of greatness, then keep me continuously in ease and comfort, till I am favoured with Your pleasure, because of my truthfulness in whatever I say, I promise and I do.

segments.translation:
On the day when they will see what they have been promised, (they will realize) that they had not tarried but an hour of the day.

On the day they see it, it will seem as if they had not tarried (in their graves) but a (single) evening, or the following morning.

When (Hannah) the wife of Imran said: âMy Lord, verily I have vowed to You that whatever is in my womb to be (exclusively) dedicated (to Your service).

segments.transliteration: yaa khaaliqan nafsi minan nafsi wa mukhrijan nafsi minan nafsi wa mukhlis'an nafsi minan nafsi khallis'haa
segments.translation:
Have not those who disbelieve seen that the heavens and the earth were closed up, and that We clove them asunder? Out of water We made all things alive. Will they not then believe?

There is a sign in the night for them. We draw off the day from it, an lo! They are in darkness.

The sun travels to an appointed place. This is the decree of the mighty, the all-knowing (Lord).

And the moon-We have determined stages for it till it returns like the old (dried) branch of a palm-tree.

It is not permitted to the sun that it should overtake the moon, nor can the night outsrip the day; each in an orbit, they float. A sign unto them is that We bear their offspring in the laden ark; And We have created for them of the like thereof whereon they ride.

If We will, We can drown them, then there shall be no one to help them, nor shall they be rescued.

Save by way of mercy from Us (to enable them) to enjoy themselves for a while.
When the trumpet is blown, then lo! From their graves unto their Lord they shall be hastening.

segments.translation:
On the day when they will see what they have been promised, (they will realize) that they had not tarried but an hour of the day. A (clear) deliverance (of the message this is). So none will be destroyed save those who transgress.
On the day they see it, it will seem as if they had not tarried (in their graves) but a (single) evening, or the following morning.

segments.translation:
The birth-pangs led her to the trunk of a palm-tree. âWould that I had died before thisâ, she said, âand had been a thing forgotten, lost in oblivion!â

Then (a voice) called her from beneath her: âDo not grieve; verily your Lord has made a river flow right below you.

segments.translation:
Verily, with every difficulty there is ease, Verily with every difficulty there is ease.

O people, fear your Lord. Verily, the quake of the hour is a terrible thing!
The day you shall behold it, every suckling mother shall forsake her suckling, and every pregnant female shall drop her load. Your shall behold the people (as) drunken, yet they will not be drunken, but the wrath of Allah will be terrible.

segments.translation: O Allah, O easer of sorrow, and remover of grief, the Beneficent of the world and the Hereafter and their Merciful. Have mercy on so and so daughter of so and so with such a mercy that she becomes needless of the mercy of all Your creation. segments.translation: Do not those who disbelieve see that the heavens and the earth were closed up, but We have opened them; and We have made of water everything living, will they not then believe?[31]

segments.translation: And a sign to them is the night: We draw forth from it the day, then lo! they are in the dark; And the sun runs on to a term appointed for it; that is the ordinance of the Mighty, the Knowing. And (as for) the moon, We have ordained for it stages till it becomes again as an old dry palm branch. Neither is it allowable to the sun that it should overtake the moon, nor can the night outstrip the day; and all float on in a sphere. And a sign to them is that We bear their offspring in the laden ship. And We have created for them the like of it, what they will ride on. And if We please, We can drown them, then there shall be no succorer for them, nor shall they be rescued, But (by) mercy from Us and for enjoyment till a time.[32]

segments.translation: We said: Strike the rock with your staff. So there gushed from it twelve springs.[42] And We made water to flow forth in the land in springs, so the water gathered together according to a measure already ordained.[43] Then I said: Ask forgiveness of your Lord, surely He is the most Forgiving: He will send down upon you the cloud, pouring down abundance of rain.[44] In this way increase the breast milk of this woman and make it pure and enough for those who nurse at her. May Allah bless our chief, Muhammad the Prophet (s.a.w.a.) and there is no Power and Strength, except by Allah, the Exalted and the Mighty.[45]

segments.translation:
In the name of Allah and by Allah, this aqiqa (sheep slaughtered) is of (mention the name of the child with fatherâs name); its flesh (instead of) his/her flesh, its blood (instead of) his/her blood, its bones, (instead of) his/her bones (are offered) to You. O Allah, (accept it) as that by which (this child) may be protected and preserved, in the name of the children of Muhammad, blessings of Allah be on him and on his children, and peace.

In the name of Allah, by Allah, praise be to Allah, Allah is the greatest, faith is in Allah, thanks to the messenger of Allah (blessings of Allah be on him and on his children) for safeguarding His command, gratitude for His sustenance, and awareness of us Ahl ul Bayt (our merits) by His grace.

O Allah, verily You have given us a son. You alone know what You have given and what has been granted, and (You alone know everything about) whatever You create. So accept (our offering offered) in accordance with Your command and the traditions of Your prophet and messenger (blessings of Allah be on him and on his children), and keep away the accursed Shaytan from us. This blood is pouring out for Your sake only (a.s.) there is no partner to share (it) with You, O my Allah, praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds. O my Allah, this meat (instead of) his meat, this blood (instead of) his blood, these bones (instead of) his bones., these hair (instead of) his hair, this skin (instead of) his skin (are offered to You), so O my Allah, accept this (sacrifice) instead of the sacrifice of (mention the name of the child.

So take away from him the pain of the knife in his circumcision and his scarification through a command â You are more knowing of it than I, O God. segments.translation: âBe grateful to Me and to your parents. To Me is the ultimate return.â

segments.translation: They disbelieved in it before, and conjectured about the unseen from a far off place. A gulf shall be created between them and that which they will (eagerly) desire, as was done in the past for the likes of them. Verily they were also in disquieting doubt.

segments.transliteration: rabbi as'lih lee fee d'urriyyatee innee tubtu ilayka wa innee minal muslimeen
segments.translation:
On that day they shall follow the summoner (straight); no crookedness (can they show) him, and the voices shall be lowered before Arrahman, and you shall not hear a sound but the lightest footfall. On that day no intercession shall be of any service other than his whom Arrahman grants permission, and whose word He is pleased to accept. He knows what is before them and what is behind them, while they do not comprehend it with (their) knowledge.

Allah faces shall be humble before the everliving, the self-subsisting, and whosoever bears a load of iniquity will certainly be disappointed. And whosoever does good deeds, and is a believer, shall not fear injustice, nor any curtailment (of what is his due).

segments.translation: O Lord, do good to me with regard to my offspring. Verily I turn repentant to You, andverily I am one of those who submit.

segments.translation: Say (O Muhammad): âIf you love Allah, then follow me: Allah will love you and forgive you your sins, verily. Allah is forgiving merciful."

fasubh'aanallad'ee biyadihee malakootu kulli sshay-iw wa ilayhi turja-o'on

wa laa h'awla wa laa quwwata illaa billahil a'liyyil a'z'eem

segments.translation:
Therefore glory be o Him in whose hand in the kingdom of all things. Unto Him you will all return.

There is no might nor strength with (any one) save Allah, the high, the great.

segments.translation: Muhammad is not the father of any man among you, but a messenger of Allah, and the seal of the prophets. Allah is the knower of all things.

segments.translation: Indeed a messenger from among you has come to you. Any distress that befalls you grieves him, (he is) most kind and merciful to the believers.

allahumma s'alli a'laa muh'ammadin wa aali muh'ammad
segments.translation: He loves them and who love Him, humble towards the believers, mighty against the infidels.

segments.translation:
O my Allah, send blessings on Muhammad and on the progeny of Muhammad.

Then say - Allah is He whose help is to be sought against what you describe. O my helper. O my affectionate Lord, save me from every anguish.
O my Allah, send blessings on Muhammad and on the progeny of Muhammad.

segments.translation: (Al Aziz said:) âIgnore this affair, O Yusuf; and you (O my wife) ask forgiveness for your sin; verily you have been of the guilty.â And the women in the city said: âThe wife of al Aziz (nobleman of high rank) seeks to seduce here page from his (pure) self. Verily he has inflamed her with violent love. Verily we see her in manifest error.â
O my Allah, send blessings on Muhammad and on the children of Muhammad.

segments.translation: Verily those who believe and do good deeds, ARRAHMAN will appoint for them love.

segments.translation:
It is He who strengthened you with His help and with the believers.
He has put affection between their hearts. Had you spent all that is in the earth you could not have put affection between their hearts, but Allah put affection between them; verily He is mighty, wise.

If you ask them: âWho created the heavens and the earth?â

He who made the earth for you as a cradle, and laid out paths upon it for you so that you may be rightly guided.

Who sends down water from the heaven in due measure; then We raise to life with it a land which was dead-so shall We bring you forth (from your graves on the day of resurrection).

He who created pairs of every thing and made for you ships and cattle on which you ride,

So that (when) you sit firm and square on their backs, and remember the bounty of your Lord, and when so seated, you may say: âGlory be to Him who subjected these to us, because we were not able to do so ourselves.

segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
